method: The referenced ImageGen sheet and a localized generated detail were assembled. The detail-edit record identifies their hashes and placement.
request:
Edit the first input image, the selected storyboard. Preserve the existing four landscape panel positions in a 2×2 grid, exact original numbered SHOT_ badges, original palette/compositions and actor likeness. The second input is original family visual reference. Dan blue / left watch, Maya plum with ponytail, Nina teal auburn waves, Leo orange, braided Ella in denim overalls, small Max green. A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. Third guide is the real park and the just-preceding approved-for-continuity draft: match the original small CLEAR PLASTIC WATER BOTTLES with ribbed BLUE SCREW CAPS in every shot, all identical apart from owner/remaining water. Eliminate colored metal flasks, tumblers or tall thermoses. 065 exactly Dan, Max and Ella continue with their existing partly eaten one sandwich and one owned clear bottle each; no second servings. 066 show all SIX original family members together on the blue/white checked blanket during the final bites, SIX and only SIX clear BLUE-CAP bottles positioned by their respective diners. Crumbs on six used plates, no fresh sandwich. 067 exactly Ella, Leo and Dan put the stack of six used white plates in the blue-handled wicker basket and the used napkins into the existing small washable soft DRAWSTRING waste pouch, visible gathered fabric at the mouth and cord, absolutely no rectangular zippered case. 068 exactly Maya, Nina and Max at cooler; all SIX capped clear plastic bottles go upright INSIDE ONE open cooler (two rows of three blue caps visible), with existing ice packs at the sides. Max only points to HIS cap in the cooler; no separate seventh bottle in his hand and no solid metal flasks. His eyes can check the grass without wandering. Show exact four labels and keep sunny park, picnic blanket and original wardrobe.
SHOT_065 shows only DAN, MAX, ELLA in PARK_OAK_PICNIC. A gentle pause lets fountain sounds fill the park. Max hears it from shade and notes it did not change places during their detour. Ella grins at Dan. End: Peaceful reaction moment before closing meal beats. Existing artwork error: Dan, Max and Ella hold partly eaten sandwiches; colored metal flasks replace clear waters. Fix: Restore clear plastic blue-cap waters.
SHOT_066 shows only DAN, MAYA, NINA, LEO, ELLA, MAX in PARK_OAK_PICNIC. A clearly signaled mealtime ellipsis shows everyone finish their one sandwich and drink as desired. Small remaining crumbs stay on plates. No additional sandwich appears in basket or cooler. End: All six sandwiches eaten; six used plates/napkins and owned water bottles remain. Existing artwork error: Six hold last bites. Six differently colored flasks replace identical clear waters. Fix: Use original bottles and lock six positions.
SHOT_067 shows only ELLA, LEO, DAN in PARK_OAK_PICNIC. Ella and Leo stack six used plates into the basket, with Dan holding it steady. They put used napkins into the washable waste pouch, not the cooler. Bottle caps stay with bottles. End: Basket holds six used plates and closed waste pouch; blanket clearing. Existing artwork error: Children return used dishes; zipper bag replaces earlier drawstring waste pouch. Fix: Keep original waste-pouch design.
SHOT_068 shows only MAYA, NINA, MAX in PARK_OAK_PICNIC. Maya checks around blanket edges while Nina collects six water bottles into cooler upright. Max spots his own cap secured on bottle, then checks grass for a loose wrapper without wandering. End: Six capped bottles in cooler with ice; no litter around blanket. Existing artwork error: Five metal flasks in cooler plus the sixth in Max's hand; six in total. Wrong vessel type. Fix: Replace five plus one with matching original waters and ice packs.
